text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick note for Berlin hub folks: floors 3-6 will be closed for phased renovations Mon-Wed, June 14-16. We're arranging coworking options and travel support.

Noah (People Ops): Summary: hub closed 14-16 Jun. Coworking passes available; one-night hotel stipend if your commute >90km. RSVP form (internal) live now.

Elias (Facilities): Scope: carpet, HVAC, drop-ceiling work. Noise and restricted desk access from 8am Mon. Lobby/staff entrance stays open.

Hana (Eng): Interviews scheduled next week?

Maya (People Ops): Default move to virtual. If a candidate needs in-person, we'll book partner space. Ping People Ops with names.

Noah (People Ops): Coworking partners: WeWork Potsdamer Platz (company rate), Betahaus Kreuzberg (day passes), Satellite hub. Book via the RSVP.

TransitBot: Public transit alert: S-Bahn works may add ~20min delay Mon-Wed mornings.

Elias (Facilities): Hotel stipend: up to EUR 120 one night if commute >90km. Submit receipts within 14 days.

Hana (Eng): Any quiet rooms? I need a low-stim workspace.

Maya (People Ops): Yes  we've reserved two quiet rooms at Betahaus and one at WeWork. Mark "quiet room" on RSVP.

Noah (People Ops): Food/per diem: EUR 20/day when using coworking on closed days. Add "Berlin renovation" to expense notes.

Elias (Facilities): Secure storage: Partner Space A will accept labeled monitors/docks 9am-6pm. Remove personal items by Fri 6/11 or we'll store them off-site.

Maya (People Ops): RSVP deadline for stipends/rooms: June 1. If you miss it, DM People Ops and we'll triage.

Hana (Eng): Thanks  appreciate the heads-up.

Noah (People Ops): Follow-up tomorrow with booking links and storage map. Code of conduct applies at partner sites; report issues to people-ops@redwood.ai.

TransitBot: Coworking pass created: Hana - Betahaus (2026-06-15). Ref PASS-9876.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all  reach out for accommodations. :clipboard:
